segments.description: Please welcome Severine Tambarero. She's a high-performance coach, speaker, consultant, author and TV analyst. Being involved in the tennis world for more than 30 years, she graduated from the National Institute of Coaching in Montreal and holds her Level 4 National Coaching Certification and is a tennis professional association member in Canada since 2008. Severine is a renowned international speaker, but she also owns her own consultancy firm, where she works closely with parents, athletes, coaches and federations of a variety of different sports. Working in Tennis Canada as a travelling national coach and the Director of Development for players aged 10 to 15 years, Severine captained the 2022 Under 14 Girls World Cup team and led the national wheelchair tennis team from 2000 to 2009, coaching at three Paralympic games, Sydney, Athens and Beijing and numerous World Cups for the men's national team.
